question: which month has the best rating
final_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', review_date) AS review_month, ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS average_rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 ORDER BY average_rating DESC LIMIT 500
